name: BurnIt
detailed_description:
🔥 BurnIt – A Puzzle Game Where Fire is Just the Beginning 🔥

BurnIt is a physics-based puzzle game where cause and effect rule everything. Inspired by classics like Lemmings and The Incredible Machine, this game challenges you with intricate puzzles that require creativity and experimentation to solve.

🎮 What is BurnIt?

In BurnIt, your goal is to complete levels using a wide variety of interactive elements and a physics engine that makes every playthrough unique. What started as a simple "burn things" game quickly evolved into a complex puzzle system with multiple mechanics:

🔥 Regular fire & blue fire – Some objects can only be burned with the right type of fire.
🎈 Balloons & gravity control – Use balloons to lift objects and manipulate gravity to your advantage.
🔄 Rotating platforms & springs – Control movement and guide objects to their destination.
📦 Gravity-altering boxes – Change how objects behave and discover unexpected solutions.
🛠️ Level editor – Create, share, and play custom levels from the community.

🧠 A True Challenge for Puzzle Lovers

What seemed like a simple idea at first turned out to be a much bigger challenge than expected. BurnIt is not just a logic-based game—it’s a test of patience and experimentation, where even the smallest change in physics can completely alter a puzzle’s solution.

To ensure that every puzzle works exactly as designed, BurnIt remains in its original version, preserving its unique physics system.

🌍 Endless Content & Community Levels

BurnIt doesn’t just offer dozens of handcrafted levels—it also features a level editor and online sharing system, allowing players to create, upload, and play custom puzzles from the community. With constant new challenges and a thriving player base, there’s always something fresh to experience.
